hypotheses.subject: api.io-pay.example
hypotheses.summary: io-shop's upstream payment provider api.io-pay.example began returning HTTP 503 for card lookups at 15:19, driving account-page errors to 100% and p50 latency to ~2s (retry/timeout cost). No change was deployed to io-shop in the preceding week, and restarting the process did not help, which is consistent with the fault living outside the service.

supporting_evidence.claim: ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - PaymentProviderFailed: api.io-pay.example returned 503 for /v1/shoppers/shopper-23719-5-1/card at src/io_shop/payment_provider.py:95
WARN io-shop: account page error rate at 100% over the last minute
error_rate 1.0, p50_ms 2040 (baseline ~45ms) from this minute onward
Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-09-13T00:00:00Z to 2026-09-20T15:30:00Z: (nothing changed in this window)
WARN io-shop: process terminated / INFO io-shop: process started - heap reclaimed to 440MiB, followed immediately by continued PaymentProviderFailed 503 errors at 100%

hypotheses.summary: Alternative reading: the 503s could be self-inflicted - io-shop hammering the provider or exhausting a client connection pool - but memory is flat at ~460MB of a 2GB limit across the whole span and a restart cleared the heap without changing behaviour, so a local resource leak is not supported.
